notes.title: New Game Demo : C.U.P.I.D
notes.notes:
So... I made a little demo celebrating April the 14th also known as Black Day in South Korea. An unofficial holiday where people who did not receive gifts on the previous love holidays gather and eat jajangmyeon, noodles with black sauce.

It's a comedic satire and I was really conflicted on whether or not to announce it at all, but yeah why not. If you're bored and wanna check it out, please go ahead and head here :  
[url=https://ceylonentertainment.itch.io/cupid]https://ceylonentertainment.itch.io/cupid[/url]

notes.title: NEW PROJECT ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
We're aliiive!! Barely, but alive nonetheless.

Sorry for being MIA for 2 years, damn. We were too focused on creating our new Visual Novel, Lingering, which can be purchased on steam here:  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343220/LINGERING/]LINGERING[/url]

We know that may not be the update you were hoping for, and we apologize for that. But we do have our reasons why we focused so hard on Lingering. Mostly due to personal issues (that you can sum up in our Lingering annpuncement page) and PC issues that cause lots of Amplitude data to be corrupted or lost. That, and my art has changed overtime so I could not replicate or create new content for Amplitude even if I want to. 

We fully understand if our silence has made you lost your faith in us and us losing your valuable support. We just want to say sorry and thank you for giving Amplitude a shot. We know we have no right to ask, but if you are so kind to give Lingering a shot, we would be very grateful.

Thank you,

Ceylon Entertainment.

notes.title: Amplitude F.A.Q
notes.notes:
AMPLITUDE F.A.Q
So we won't be posting a walkthrough yet, but we still like to post some F.A.Q for anyone wondering about the game!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30540786/eecf795fc6a71416018b106020d79e1835363d54.jpg[/img]

Q : Is there any differences if I use Adam/Eve or Katy/Jon?
A : Yes! your killer will be different when you choose Adam/Eve. There will be different quests and character routes if you choose Jon/Katy. All in all the story will be quite different, there are things revealed in Jon's route that won't be revealed in Katy's and vice versa

Q : Who are romanceable?
A : For Katy, it's Ari, Simon, Jon and Theo. For Jon, it's Luna, Katy, Liz, Grace and a cockroach. You can also befriend others though in non-romanceable routes. It is fully optional to date anyone though

Q : Can you do all quest in one go?
A : No, the quests are made so you can play them at another playthrough, so you won't get bored. You can try though, we've never succeed at least. We do recommend you do The library Quest, FQ Fanatic.

Q : What do stats do?
A : They affect your character route endings and some cgs won't pop out unless you fulfill certain stats (one of the pictures is the one attached. You won't get this unless you have a high enough athletic stat and do one of Cam's Quest)

Q : Do messages have any effect?
A : Yes, they can affect your stats and moral bar which affect your ending

Q : How many endings are there?
A : 5 Endings, 3 of them bad , 1 true ending if you're in good terms with your soul and 1 good ending

Q : Walkthrough?
A : Soon!

Q : Will there be a another project?
A : We have another project in mind, an android game for free (with ads). But we need proof that you want it too! So we decide to continue making Vns if we reached 10.000 downloads! We might post a sneak peek of what the project is if anyone is interested.
